definition.proposition: Channel-wise (per-key-dim) decay beats GDN's head-wise scalar decay in a hybrid: Kimi Linear vs GDN-H, e.g. MMLU-Pro 51.0 vs 47.9, RULER 84.3 vs 80.5, long-context avg 54.5 vs 51.2; faster MQAR/palindrome convergence (Fig. 4). **No isolated scalar-vs-channel PPL ablation is reported**
